title: #007. Worker-Task 1-to-1 Assignment
subtitle: Enforce exact row sums and column sums over a 0-1 decision matrix for minimum-cost matching.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignment, totalCost }.
judge.m1: assignment[{p0}] must be an integer task index (received {p1}).
judge.m3: Task {p0} is assigned more than once — check your column-sum == 1 constraints.
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cost sum ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid 1-to-1 assignment, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
